title: Soft Clay
line: Rounded 3D clay under studio light: lilac ground, friendly purple, a bouncy lo-fi bed.
line_zh: 棚拍光下的圆润黏土 3D：淡紫底，友好的紫色，弹跳的低保真配乐。
prompt: Soft clay style: rounded 3D clay figures and props on a pale lilac studio set, dark plum ink and one friendly purple, soft bokeh, elastic pop-in type, gentle dissolves and swipe-ups, a warm lo-fi bed with pops and a boing.
prompt_zh: 柔软黏土风格：淡紫色棚景中圆润的 3D 黏土人物与道具，深梅色文字与一抹友好的紫色，柔和散景，弹性出现的字效，轻柔叠化与上滑转场，温暖的低保真配乐，配弹出声与弹簧声。
essence: Toy-like and warm: soft rounded forms in even studio light, a friendly colour and motion that bounces a little. The pack renders the clay set in 3D; the type sits beside it.

not.difference: Paper Cut is flat craft layers; Soft Clay is rounded 3D under studio light.
Kinetic Poster is loud flat type; Soft Clay is quiet 3D with small type.

palette.logic: a pale lilac set, dark plum ink, ONE friendly purple that matches the clay figures

camera.expresses: a turn around the clay set
a gentle move toward a figure

sound.foley: pops, a xylophone run and a boing

signature_features.text: dark plum ink on lilac at 12:1, purple at 5:1 (contrast.py)
rounded 3D clay plates from the pack (no flat clip art)
a warm lo-fi bed with pops and a boing
